prompt.content: In what year was The Armory Show on view at the Art Institute of Chicago that led to the founding of the Arts Club of Chicago?

output:
The Armory Show was on view at the Art Institute of Chicago from February 10 to April 18, 1913. The Arts Club of Chicago was founded in February 1913.
